subject: TopBank - Enterprise access controls & SCIM/SSO cutover
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@topbank.com>, Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@topbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: TopBank - Enterprise access controls & SCIM/SSO cutover

Hi Olivia / Sam —

Thanks for the intro call today. As promised, I wanted to pull the access-control items into a short plan so we can align owners and blockers before we pick a cutover date. High-level list for this thread: SSO (SAML metadata exchange), SCIM provisioning mapping and token, IP allowlist (egress & inbound), service-account usage for provisioning, and org-level policies (session durations, admin roles).

Quick asks for your team to prep:
- IdP vendor and SAML metadata (Okta / Azure / Ping etc).
- SCIM attributes you currently use (employeeNumber, costCenter, title) — if you have an existing mapping CSV, please attach.
- IP ranges for your firewall to allow Redwood egress and any internal endpoints we need to reach.
- Any org policies (MFA exceptions, admin group names) that should be preserved during provisioning.

Proposal: Neha (SE) will provide the SCIM mapping and token guidance; Marissa (CSM) will own the mutual action plan and kickoff cadence; I will coordinate the cutover plan and the canary rollout (1 team, monitor logs, then org-wide).

Can you confirm the IdP and share the SCIM mapping and allowlist ranges? If possible, we can target a cutover window the week of Oct 4 — but happy to adjust to your compliance calendar.

Attachments: redwood_sso_quickstart.pdf (SSO checklist & metadata endpoints)

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@topbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@topbank.com>, security@topbank.com
Date: 2026-08-29T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: TopBank - Enterprise access controls & SCIM/SSO cutover

Jonas — thanks, this is helpful. A few answers and clarifying questions: 

- IdP: Okta (org: topbank.okta.com). We can export SAML metadata; I will attach the file in a follow-up.
- SCIM: we currently sync users from HRIS via Okta; primary attributes are email, givenName, familyName, employeeNumber, department, costCenter. I can get our current mapping CSV.
- IP allowlist: Security wants a canonical list of Redwood egress IPs and whether you support ranges or only fixed addresses. We also need to know if Redwood supports connecting via a static outbound IP for our VPC peering option.
- Service accounts: we use dedicated service accounts for provisioning. Do you require a particular naming convention or token rotation cadence?
- Audit logs: Compliance asked how long Redwood retains provisioning/audit logs and whether we can export them (S3 or Syslog).

We aim for the cutover the week of Oct 4 but must finalize by EOD Sep 10 (change freeze windows and audit review). Can Neha share the exact SCIM endpoints and token scope so I can route to our security team?

—Olivia
Olivia Chen
IT Identity Manager | TopBank
olivia.chen@topbank.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@topbank.com>, Samuel Ortiz <sam.ortiz@topbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: TopBank - Enterprise access controls & SCIM/SSO cutover

Great — thanks for the quick answers, Olivia. Short replies inline: 

- Redwood egress: we publish a small set of static IPv4 ranges; I'm attaching the allowlist text (allowlist_ips.txt) in the next message — the ranges are also on our docs site. We support both fixed ranges and an enterprise VPC peering option (the peering option is in Redwood Private; let's flag if you need a static single IP egress).
- Service accounts: we recommend a read/write SCIM service account named like redwood-scim-topbank and a scoped API key with 90-day rotation; we include rotation tooling in the onboarding playbook.
- Audit logs: Redwood retains provisioning and audit logs for 90 days by default with enterprise retention add-on options (S3 export available). We can enable a longer retention for compliance (please share retention SLA required).

Next steps I propose:
1) Neha shares SCIM mapping + sample token steps (today).
2) Olivia uploads TopBank mapping + firewall ranges (by Sep 3).
3) We schedule a technical cutover dry run (canary) the week of Sep 21 — if that works for your change windows, otherwise move to Oct 4 as discussed.

I'll loop back once Neha posts the technical doc.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@topbank.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Technical: SCIM mapping, tokens, and service-account specifics

Olivia / team — attaching the SCIM mapping CSV and a short technical checklist. Highlights below and an example mapping is attached as topbank_scim_mappings.csv.

Checklist / notes:
- SCIM endpoint: POST/PUT to https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/scim/TopBank
- Auth: Bearer token with scope scim:write and scim:read. We recommend issuing a long-lived token on your side and storing it in your secrets manager; Redwood also supports us generating a scoped token on behalf of customers during onboarding.
- Attribute mapping: map employeeNumber -> externalId (we avoid primary key collisions by prefixing with TB-). If you want us to mirror costCenter, include costCenter in the mapping (we'll provide exact CSV headers).
- Service account: name: redwood-scim-topbank; least privilege: scim:read, scim:write; rotation: 90 days recommended.
- SCIM delta sync: Redwood supports incremental sync via ims: bulk delta — set the delta window to 5m for production.

I've included sample SCIM headers in the attachment and a small sample payload. Also note: if TopBank's Okta uses custom claim names, include a short mapping table.

Attachments: topbank_scim_mappings.csv (CSV with attribute_name,scim_path,required)

Subject: Re: Technical: SCIM mapping, tokens, and service-account specifics

Thanks Neha — attaching our current mapping and the firewall ranges as allowlist_ips.txt. A couple of follow-ups from Security:

- Retention: Compliance asks for a 2-year retention for provisioning logs. Is that available as an enterprise add-on? Please confirm export format (S3) and whether logs include full before/after snapshots.
- Token rotation: we prefer not to manage rotation manually. Is there an automated rotation integration you support or a webhook you can call to request a new token?

We confirm cutover target: Oct 6 (production cutover), and we would like a dry run Sept 22 for the main user population. Can you add those dates to the MAP?

Attachments: allowlist_ips.txt

—Olivia
